files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+name: publish
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    branches: [main]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  packages: write
+jobs:
+  publish:
+    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
+    uses: some-org/release-tools/.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml@9f2a4c1e8b7d63a05c4e2f1b9d8a7c3e5f6021ab
+    with:
+      image_name: core-api
+    secrets:
+      REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN }}

note: Globally clean: full-SHA pin, least-privilege permissions, fork guard, explicit single-secret mapping.
